The money you spend here is very comparable to how much you would spend on a conventional fiber supplement, protein supplement and green supplement, but you are getting a far superior product!

title: Feel full longer
body: This product is so filling! I have done juice cleanses oh, and found myself starving not with this! One drink and I am full The taste is not bad either. It actually feels healthy being ingested

title: You'll love the proteini!
body: I'm really enjoying these products so far, and I've definitely benefited from using them. My favorite is the Vegan Vanilla Proteini. I just take two scoops of it, add some organic soy milk, a banana, and a bunch of strawberries, and I have the perfect meal. It is exactly what I need to get through the day.

title: Easy way to fuel your body!
body: I tried some samples of the Smart Juices and immediately bought the whole pack the next week. I really like the that the proteini is vegan as I sometimes feel bloated from my whey protein and the greens make me feel less guilty if I don't get all the greens in I would like to everyday. I am looking forward to incorporating this into my everyday routine!

title: Great stuff
body: I’ve used this product for the last 3 months absolutely love it

title: Product caused nausea
body: After just one day of the 7 day cleanse, this product caused nausea so I discontinued use. I was planning to return the product, but just realized it is not eligible for return (even though all of the other containers are unopened and in the original package). This is most unfortunate, especially since I spent $218.95 on the product (7 day cleanse and maintenance program). I should have paid closer attention to the return policy. What a shame to have spent so much and not be able to recoup any of my funds! I am extremely disappointed.

title: Not a juice cleanse but a life change-ponds will fall off
body: This is the first product that I’ve used that not only tasted good but actually work for weight loss.  I bought this after using the 7 day cleanse and was shocked that I lost over 9 lbs in the first week.  I continue to lose pounds  and inches.

title: Delicious
body: The products all tasted great and mixed well (no chunks of powder). I mixed them with almond milk or white grape/apple juice. I had been getting into better shape, but had plateaued, so I bought the Smart pressed Juice to try to kick my body back into gear. Sadly, it did not work for me. My usual diet mainly consists of raw fruits/veg, chicken/fish/peanut butter, so maybe it would work better for someone with worse eating habits. I noticed no change in my energy level, and I did not feel the need to snack.

title: Surprisingly delicious 😋
body: I wanted to do a cleanse and thought this was a promising choice... it’s fantastic! Tastes great ... easy easy easy to use (no blender.. no extra ingredients...) has everything your body needs so you feel satisfied.. not full but not hungry... I noticed my skin is getting much clearer and I have more energy ... I’m 52 and menopause changed my skin ... weird bumps and rosacea redness.... it’s smoothing out and looking better.... so ... I’m going to continue to use this for meal replacement or a cleanse every so often ... thankful I found this very helpful and delicious product (s)

title: I love love love these products
body: I love love love these products, i was skeptical about the greens!!it's my favorite one! It really is a better deal to buy the 3 in bulk like this...i highly recommend

title: Not a miracle weight-loss drink, but has felt-benefits.
body: Nice packaging. Took a bit to get used to the taste. Definitely took the recommendation to use coconut milk with the vanilla protein and the pineapple cleanse, and the apple juice with the green powder. Didn’t see significant weight loss, but did feel less bloated. The shakes curbed my appetite mostly and helped me detox from all the junk food I had been eating, so I’d consider that a win.

title: Good Tasting For A Cleanse
body: I loved how everything tasted (but I suggest mixing the greens with juice). It didn’t feel like I was on a cleanse! I only did the 1 day cleanse, and didn’t notice any changes because I feel I needed to do at least a 3 day to really reset my system. That’s the only reason I’m not giving 5 stars. But I would definitely try the 3 day cleanse!

title: lost 2 lbs in one day, wasn't hungry in the evening
body: First time juicing. I bought two protein smoothies and one acai juice to mix in with the meal packs.  The taste was pleasant when mixed with the smoothies and juice. I was worried about the last meal as the gap between last meal and going to sleep seemed worrying but it was fine. Ate a few almonds at the end of the day.  The next day I was down two pounds. This weight has since been regained but juicing was overall a good experience.

title: Great product
body: This product helped me get through a 21 day fast on the days I didn't have time to make fresh juice. Great product!!

title: Eh. there are probably better ones out there.
body:
I purchased this product out of sheer curiosity. It was the cheapest "juice" cleanse I could find, and it is helpful that it is in powdered form. Here are my thoughts.
1. Vanilla protein powder: yuck. honestly, you can get the same amount of calories in a better tasting protein shake. this tastes like chalk and is honestly really hard to finish. I choked it down (milked with vanilla oat milk and a drop of stevia), but it was rough. I will say it did keep me full.
2. Roots: this one probably is the best of the bunch. I just mixed with water and a bit of flavored sugar free Mio and it was drinkable.
3. Greens: not the best, but not as bad as the vanilla protein. I dont know if its because I made a smoothie out of it with fruit and water though.
4. Pineapple: this one again isnt "terrible" it just has a very weird texture.

All in all, If you can plug and chug, its not terrible, but if you are sensitive to taste and texture of food, steer clear.

title: Great organic product and personal results
body:
So I purchased this after a vacation and consuming lots of inflammatory foods (for me: dairy and gluten). I do not have allergies to this food, just intestinal and skin inflammations. Started this the morning after I got back and only got 3 consumed the whole day - mostly because I was still full (and you're required to eat a clean meal mid-day). It took me 5 days to do the 3 day cleanse but I actually really enjoyed it. The Greens don't taste that great but I blended with a handful of frozen berries and that helped. Almond milk and a couple ice cubes were used with the Vanilla and the Pineapple.

So fast forward 3 weeks, I'm down 4 pounds (not crazy but I was already at the tail end of my weight loss). Inflammation gone, cravings for sugar first thing are gone.

I will do this again periodically, the body reset was worth the price.

title: Better than a previous cleanse experience
body: I was pleasantly surprised at how easy it was to do a 1 day cleanse and not feel hungry, angry or otherwise out of sorts. The Protein and Greens drinks were actually really yummy, which did make it a lot easier. I'm not a fan of pineapple or chia but I did drink that as well. It wasn't as bad as I feared, but I don't think it will become part of my regular maintenance routine. Previously, I'd tried a 10 day cleanse from Purium which was nearly enough to turn me off to any future cleanse. What caught my eye here was the organic (not a bunch of chemicals) and low commitment (just 1 day). Smart Pressed Juice really tastes like juice instead of funky chemical additives. After one day, I felt "lighter" and refreshed. I wouldn't say I lost weight but I felt prepared to make some new long term health goals.

title: Bought a 2nd time
body:
Actually bought a 3rd time and this time from the manufacturer and the bulk size as now my husband wants to do with me on the next go round. In the packaging, the manufacturer gives a coupon for 25% off next purchase if you order from the website. I am 5'6" and started and 168. Didn't weigh myself the entire 3 days. Peed A LOT!!!!!! Stepped on scale at the end and weighed 159. Lost 9 pounds in 3 days. Follow instructions. Never felt week because of lack of calories. Comes with Vanilla, beats, greens and pineapple. VERY PLEASED with cleanse. Each day came in individual box to just toss in car and go.
Best with Magic bullet and ice to mix, but all settle very fast.  2nd go round just used water bottle and shook bottle vigorously. :) same effect as bullet, when needing to be on the go. Didn't focus on weight the 2nd time And added cleanse to normal eating routine

title: Not super sweet
body: Loved it! Going to do the 3 day next. Was feeling a little bloated and it really helped me. Loved that it wasn't super sweet. I hate when you have a protein shake that you feel like is all sugar.

title: Taste great
body: Great product, the taste is great and I lost 4 pounds in just 3 days. I also feel less bloated.

title: Loved the variety
body:
Loved the variety in flavors, made it much more tolerable. Lost 5 lbs in 3 days and was able to successfully finish the 3 day cleanse.
I purchased 2 others a friend and cousin.  I will be doing this again.

title: Nutritious and (almost) delicious :-P
body: I was honestly a bit skeptical as I’ve heard negative research on juicing due to low fiber and high sugar which ultimately just isn’t good for any persons goals but I wanted a quick 3-day reset after having a busy weekend filled junk food and I had some food allergy related issues as a result.  I had seen a one-day reset juice package at Whole Foods for 50$ and the sugar content was over 15g per bottle (x6 bottles total) which would counter act my hope for a reset from junk. This product is powder so you can mix it into water or almond milk wherever you are, the sugar is 2g or lower, has the fiber and protein that regular juicing fails to have and It allows raw veggies/salads for lunch if need be. The Proteini was tasty, the greens and pineapple powders not as much, but tolerable. It was the perfect reset and once it was complete I felt mentally and physically refreshed.  It was so great that I ordered two more 3-day packages, one for after my upcoming vacation and one just for any other time since I loved it so much. I did feel hungry at night, after the last juice of the day but would try to have a cup of tea or kombucha to balance it. I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a quick reset.

title: Helps get you back on track!
body: This is my second time using this product. I love using the 3-day cleanse to help me get back on track with my eating habits! (I love mixing the Beets + Roots and Pressed Greens with some orange juice)

title: Convenient and clean!
body: I can't say enough good things about this product line. I love that it now comes in a convenient 1-day cleanse kit because I travel a lot and sometimes--okay, always--get off track. Having this in my carry on sets me right again. I always feel better after doing this even for a day. Thanks so much for making this!

title: Satisfied
body: Decent product, much better taste if you do a smoothie rather than straight water. Felt a little lighter after 1 day, down couple pounds. Might try a 3 day next time. Fast shipping.

title: mixed with almond/oat milk is one of the best vegan protein powder i've tried (and i've tried qui...
body: so much more convenient and affordable than the typical juice cleanse. its so much easier to follow since you are expected to eat a clean meal at lunch, i never got the empty stomach feeling. Did a few times for 3 days or so and really curved my snack/junk food cravings. the proteini powder, mixed with almond/oat milk is one of the best vegan protein powder i've tried (and i've tried quite a few!). pineapple ones is better with apple juice IMO.

title: Don't waste your money
body: I was able to look over the taste for results but I have to say, the drinks are not flavorful.  I tried them with apple juice, coconut milk and almond milk but still not good. I was willing to overlook the bad taste but unfortunately, for me I could not get through the first day. My body totally started refusing them after drink #4. I became sick to my stomach (throwing up) and had an enormous headache with vertigo. I even incorporated a lunch on day 1 that consisted of a leafy green salad, nuts and grilled chicken breast so I wasn't starving myself.  My husband survived day 1 but on day 2 he started having some major stomach issues too.  Definitely, not worth the pain and suffering they caused.  If you want to do a juice cleanse I would suggest making your own juices and not wasting the money on these pre-packaged ones. I now have 5 unopened packages that will go to waste.

title: Convenient and Healthy Option
body: I'm terrible at cleansing--I will drink a couple of juices then attack a buffet later in the day. So I used this 3-day cleanse as a way to have readily available healthy food with me during most of my hectic day, and let myself have a light lunch and dinner as well. The proteini is delicious! I loved how quickly I could get nutrition, and that I didn't have to carry heavy things around. I also really liked the green juice. I would have liked the pineapple chia to have some more substance to it (chia is easy to throw in water yourself)but I suppose the pineapple serves a cleansing function. For the proteini, I simply filled a blender bottle with almondmilk, then stirred the packet in at work. I'd reorder!

title: Tastes good and works well
body: I tried the 3 day cleanse. I expected to feel hungry but didn't. The juice did not taste bad. The first day I had a hard time with the greens but by day two discovered I was not mixing it well enough from then on i had no issues with taste. I felt great by the third day, energetic and  I had lost my stomach bloat. I plan to do it again next month.

title: Tasty and they work!
body:
I got the 3 day plan. Ate 1x a day. Stuck to a schedule. I lost 5 lbs in the 3 days.
I was on an unhealthy food binge for about a month, but now  I feel like I am back on track. I will look into the maintenance programs offered.
***NOTE Vanilla Protein is MUCH better with "milk" and the Pressed Greens are much better with Juice. The water, they were alright and tolerable, but with the recommended milk/juice, they are much, much better!

title: Great product!
body: Great reset! I did the one day cleanse and it was a good way to get back on track with better eating. I added a 1/2 banana to the protein shakes, but otherwise followed the program.  Will definitely purchase again!!!

title: Awesome Product!
body: Fantastic product! I really wasn't sure what to expect since I haven't done a cleanse before. I LOVE that it is completely plant based and only 1 gram of sugar in each packet! I am on my last day of the 3 day cleanse and I feel great! Can't wait to maintain the results with Smart Pressed Juice products!! Highly recommend!!

title: Does Your Body GOOD!
body:
I love the convenience of the pouches. No measuring, no guessing, and they were super easy to pour into a glass of water or water bottle.
I waited for the perfect opportunity to try my 1 day cleanse, July 5th! I felt horrible the morning after the 4th of July holiday with all that I had eaten and drank and knew I would need something to pick me up.
The informational mini brochure that came in the cleanse pack was AWESOME and needed as it provided an example timeline for your day, and tips and recommendations for drinks.  As directed I started off my day the vanilla protein pouch which I needed first thing in the morning to give me that full feeling so I wouldn't grab a danish. I mixed mine with Coconut milk to make it extra creamy, which was an awesome idea and tip on the pouch.
I am a regular juicer so I drank the Greens pouch straight up with water to get the true taste. It wasnt bad at all, however I will probably use less water next time to get more flavor.  The Roots pack was good as well. As with the Greens pouch I feel I should not use so much water as I am accustomed to juicing actual veggies and prefer a thicker drink.  Of course, the Pineapple Chia Cleanse was my favorite creamy drink as I mixed it with coconut milk to close out my day.  It felt like a well earned treat. By the end of the day, I could not tell I had celebrated the previous night away and that overly bloated feeling of eating too much was gone.  I was full of energy and eager to continue the cleanse a second day.

All and all I love all of the products.  My only regret is not ordering more in advance so that I could continue the cleanse.
I am excited to put this in my weekly regime.

title: Great product. Ordered the 1-day cleanse
body: Great product. Ordered the 1-day cleanse, and feel great. The instructions are easy to follow and with the single-use packets, it was easy to stay on schedule even on the go. I was able to maintain energy and didn't feel starving mid day like I did with other cleanses. Definitely recommend for anyone looking for a boost towards healthy living.

title: low sugar, organic and includes fiber
body: I chose this cleanse because they include fiber in the drinks and the price is much more reasonable than other juice cleanses. I purchased the 3 day cleanse but did one day. I was skeptical but I easily made it through the day with a large healthy organic chicken salad for lunch. I woke up feeling great - happy, energetic and definitely with a flatter stomach. The taste of the drinks is bearable. I just think of the ingredients that are in them and what the benefits of those ingredients are doing to my body. I am very glad I chose Smart Pressed over the other brands.

title: Awesome stuff!
body: This stuff is awesome. I’ve used it once a week for two weeks and am down 3 pounds!

title: Satisfied and Energetic
body: I purchased the SmartPressed 3 day cleanse as a detox and kick start for a healthier eating regime.  This was great.  The flavors and texture were fine.  Some reviews commented on the texture/flavor of the greens....they're greens and definitely not the worst I've had.  The stevia was a surprise, only because I didn't research that prior, but made the greens easier to take.  I didn't feel hungry at all during the 3 days.  My energy was good and I continued to workout during the 3-days.  I enjoyed the products so much that I purchased the Maintenance Program to continue this great feeling.  Note - for the first 2 days I mixed all 3 drinks with water.  The 3rd day I mixed the morning drink with coconut milk.  I liked both, but the coconut milk kept me a fuller longer.

title: Great reset
body:
I felt really really good after the 3day one.
This is a great reset. Will buy again

title: Great tasting, effective cleanse
body: I've only done the 1-day cleanse on two separate occasions, but the fact that I re-ordered after the first time speaks volumes! The juices taste really good mixed with apple juice as suggested on the packets, and the protein shakes taste great with just water. Including a salad with chicken for lunch, I never felt hungry or deprived. The pineapple chia drink leaves a little to be desired, but I've only used water and will use something else the next time. I plan on doing a longer cleanse with this product soon. I've tried many products, and this one is superior!

title: Miracle
body: I was 6’-4” and 330 lbs, after doing this cleanse, I am now a svelte 5’-11 190 lb Adonis. I had never been kissed by a girl, now I have have 11 kids all over the world.

title: Overall nice
body: I used 3 days cleanse and lost 3 lbs, taste is ok, I added almond milk and mixed berries with the shakes

title: Good - a little sweet!
body: If you don't mind the stevia taste, this is a good cleanse with a good philosophy. I like the encouragement to eat a meal and the mixing of the powders with juice or coconut milk. I really wasn't hungry during this cleanse (I did the 3-day) and I would get it again.

title: Great product
body:
Purchased (2) 1-day Cleanses...wish I would've just went with the 3 day. Totally could've went a third day. Felt great and full the entire time. Added combinations of frozen fruit, water, almond milk and organic OJ to a few and they tasted great. Really enjoyed the Beets+Root (this one sounded really gross but it was my favorite). Greens were kind of yuck but sucked them down.
Coming off keto and was looking for a "reset". Bonus weight loss of 1.2 lbs (probably would've lost more if I just mixed with water).
Will purchase again!

title: Effective and convenient!
body: I tried the 1-day cleanse to get a flavor of the product before I purchased a bigger package. I really love this product! It was convenient and travel-friendly. I didn’t have to take time to make a ton of smoothie concoctions as I have with other cleanses. Just pour and shake!! Abdomen was leaner and felt more energized. I plan to do the 3 day cleanse soon.

title: Great results by day 3
body:
Day 3:
I’ve lost 5 pounds. Vanilla protien shake tastes good mixed with almond milk. Greens are not my favorite, but I mix them with 4 oz. organic apple juice and 4 oz. filtered water and I can manage. The Pineapple chia cleanse tastes good as well.

Two more days to go to complete the total 5.

title: Good quality clean drink
body: i really liked this drink. it mixed really well and wasn't clumpy. Plus the ingredients are clean - 100% organic and made in the USA

title: Simple and Easy
body: Loved the convenience of this product. No need to purchase all the fruits and veggies, they did the work for you. The game plan chart specified a daily plan that kept me on target. I mixed with the recommended coconut milk and organic apple juice which created a great taste. I felt AMAZING after doing just the 1 day cleanse! I look forward to more. Thanks SmartPressedJuice

title: Very filling..taste good
body: Taste good and keeps me full, I'm not doing any meals just the 3 day cleanse. I'll update when I'm finished.

title: Great little cleanse!
body: Definatly a great little cleanse to get back on track! I usually do the 1 day cleanse  here and there but opted for the 3 day one this time to help cut down on sugar intake and some bloating. This works great and I did not feel deprived at all during the 3 days! Took away the bloating and is very gentle on the stomach! Highly reccomend.

title: The Good the Bad and the Bearable
body:
This is well-balanced, organic, easy to use and doesn't make you feeling jittery or starving. In fact, I wasn't even hungry enough for the next packet a few times... of course that could be because I hated the flavors of them ALL. But maybe it is good because it definitely helped curb my appetite. If you are a foodie or, like me, have no sweet tooth, these are all sweet. To my taste, VERY SWEET. A number of folks seem to think the green drink is the worst and for me it is the least cloying and my least favorite is definitely the protein drink (I HATE stevia).

But I did feel more energetic and dropped a couple of pounds and certainly survived it. Would I do it again? Not likely. But if you like sweet drinks (and aftertastes), then you are good to go!

3 stars for being healthy and doing what it is supposed to do.

title: Not Just Juice!
body: I love this cleanse but it's not just juice like a lot of them I have done.  If you are an active person, juice just isn't healthy for you.  This one includes (2) protein shakes and allows you (1) meal meal per day.  Very doable.

title: No cravings
body: I did the 3 day juice cleanse. Overall I really enjoyed it. Some of the flavors were better than others but none of them were bad. I like that you can eat a small meal in between the juices. I feel less bloated and feel like my pants fit a little better now. Definitely a good way to start my diet. Would buy again.

title: Great products!
body: I loved the products and will be purchasing more. After my 3 days cleanse, it makes you have so much energy and your body thanks you for that!

title: 3 day cleanse is a great way to kick start a diet
body: I bought the 3 day cleanse. I used the juices to kick off a diet plan and start off on the right foot. First, day 1 was tough. I was hungry. I didn’t like the greens drink.  Second day was easier. Third day I felt and looked great. I don’t own a scale so I cannot tell you how many pounds I lost, but my skin is clearer, my tummy is flatter and I’m more energized. Day 4:: off cleanse,  curbed cravings, and now I have the energy and mind set to eat light and work out!! Highly recommend. 4 stars because the greens one is not good. Drinkable, but not enjoyable.

title: Three Stars
body: Like to think it worked hard to say with just one day

title: I like the 3-day cleanse
body: All in all, I like the 3-day cleanse.  I found it palatable enough.  I was really surprised to find I enjoyed the vegetable snack packets when mixed with apple juice.  Pretty tasty!

title: Convenient, healthy and delicious
body: This is my favorite because I am never without a snack with this around. I keep one kicking around my car and a few in my school bags. title: Feel great... taste decent
body: So I am on day 2 out of 3. The vanilla protein isn't bad but is hard to get mixed into the coconut milk. Even with a blender bottle it seems to not be able to mix well. The greens are good, which I went with grape juice, apple juice doesn't work for me most of the time. As for the overall program, it is helping me learn better eating habits and to not snack as much. The hardest part was when my students had chips in front of me right before lunch and at night, but I've been chewing on gum to offset that. Overall I plan to do this again!

title: Fantastic cleanse that is finally giving me RESULTS!!!
body:
This has been the best cleanse I've ever tried. I've lost 10 lbs in about 5 days. I'm not hungry as the drinks in between the meals (mid-morning, mid-afternoon) really help. I love how you're ok to much on a few nuts or some fruit as well if need be. Also, love the idea of the salad/chicken for lunch. That one meal during the middle of the day really helps instead of it being a complete juice meal for the entire day. I do a spinach/mixed greens/tomatoes/cucumber salad with some sunflower seeds and sliced almonds on top, and for dressing I squeeze a whole lemon's juice and some olive oil. Sort of a fattoush style salad, and put some olive oil and seasoning marinated grilled chicken (2 medium sized pieces) and it gets me through the day as my one "food" meal. Now for mixing the powders I've done just the water and mixed it. I don't LOVE any of the flavors, but I'm picky on these kind of drinks anyways flavor wise. What I love about all the powders is they go down SUPER EASY. So dump the powder into my glass, mix in the water, and chug it real quick. Easy to chug. Not a great after-taste (especially on the mid-morning beet and the mid-afternoon celery style drink) but it goes down smooth and quick and I chase it with water and no lingering ramifications. I had the vanilla-style dinner drink last night and a banana as I was a little more hungry and made a 2 mile ride to the gym and 2 mile ride home and never felt hungry or any lingering weakness anywhere and finished the final before bed drink and was good to go. This morning was a little hungry so had a banana and I was good. This is really keeping me away from constant snacking or needing to eat heavier meals, which was my goal. Can't say enough about this product!

I do wish it was a tad cheaper and the flavor a tad better but for what it's doing for me I'll make the sacrifices money wise and flavor wise although not perfect I didn't expect it to be and as mentioned it goes down super smooth/super quick so that's ...

title: Nice flavors & easy to follow!
body:
I bought the 3-day cleanse to jump start my health journey after not eating clean due to sickness and treatments. I needed a quick way to reset my body. This was a perfect way to get everything started.

I loved the packaging (I’m a sucker for cute boxes & design), the directions were easy to follow, and I was pleasantly surprised with the flavors. I mixed most with just cold water and it was perfectly fine for me. Once, I blended the Pineapple Chia cleanse with coconut milk, and that was a nice change. Each packet kept me feeling pretty full, and i loved that a meal was allowed in the middle of the day. I always went for a salad with lean chicken or fish.

I wasn’t looking to lose any weight since I was just looking for a reset, but I did drop a couple pounds!
I’d try this again and definitely recommend this cleanse to anyone looking for a reset!

title: Good product!!
body: I really like this program.  I was able to complete a 3day cleanse and was not miserable!  The taste is good, I used water and nut milks to blend.  I will be buying again.

title: Great Cleanse!
body: I bought this for a new year’s reset to help rid by body of toxins and help kick start a healthier lifestyle before I start my Keto Diet again. I initially bought this because of the great price and low sugar content. I ordered the 3 day to keep the other 2 for the day after a cheat day.  I mixed the vanilla protein with water & Yuck. I mixed the pressed green juice with organic apple juice and it was surprisingly really good! The afternoon vanilla protein I mixed with almond milk and it was much better. For lunch I had a spinach and kale salad with chicken which saved the day. I was starting to get really hungry but the ability to have a solid meal made it much better. The pineapple chia cleanse I mixed with organic apple juice and it was delicious!  I felt a little off the first day because I did not have my morning coffee and no candy but at the end of the day I felt great. I definitely recommend this product and will use again and again.

title: Couldn’t Complete Day 1
body: Overall the score of a 3 was based on the customer service and the fact that Jen reached out and made things right after we connected on the FB page. I was not impressed by the taste - at all, in fact I couldn't finish it! Jen was fantastic and when she found out she refunded my money and made things right. Thank you.

title: No such thing as a "quick fix" but this comes close.
body:
I'll start with my results after trying the 3-day cleanse, since I'm sure that's why most people are reading these reviews:
I lost 5 lbs after day 1, another 2 lbs after day 2, and as of the morning of day 3 I am down a total of 8.3 lbs. These three days did not include any kind of extra exercise. I feel lighter, less bloated, and overall more energetic. Most of the weight lost was most likely water weight (I was peeing every half hour), but this cleanse is a good way to kick-start a longer-term change in diet, and my pants fit me better after the cleanse than they did before, so I will call that a net win overall.

A few details on how this went for me:

After going a little too long binging on junk food, takeout, and unhealthy snacks I was ready to kick my diet back into gear. My pants were getting tighter (even my leggings -- yikes), and overall I just felt gross, tired, and unhealthy. I'm not big on "fad" diets and have never tried any kind of juice cleanse before, but after reading reviews and looking at the nutrition facts and ingredients in these juices, I decided to give it a try.

This plan works even if you only approach it as a calorie restriction plan -- if you only had the juices, you'd be consuming 310 calories per day. Do this for even a day and you'll no doubt shed a few pounds -- that's just how calories work. I did follow their recommended plan and had one healthy meal per day (usually some variety of chicken and vegetable soup and salad), as well as a few handfuls of nuts or fruit for snacks, and I still wasn't able to consume more than about 850-900 calories per day. The juices are filling and there were times I wasn't hungry enough for the next pack.

title: Better than Expected and Inexpensive
body:
Juicing vegetables has always been part of my healthy diet. I avoid commercialized juices as they typically contain too much sugar.

Instead I would buy fresh made-to-order veggie juices from organic health bars but it gets expensive at $5 per serving, and sometimes I would juice my own but it takes a lot of time prepping, washing and cleaning up at the end.

Based on my juicing experiences, for a powdered mix I initially didn't have high expectations. After finding the right balance mixing with water, this product is surprisingly tasty. It's versatile, convenient and saves lots of time. Also inexpensive if you factor in dollar per serving. For those of you commenting negatively on the taste, you might be used to veggie juices with some sugar in it. Since it's versatile, you can start with blending some organic apple juice, then slowly work your way to a refreshing sugar-free mix with water. Good luck and be healthy!

body:

All by themselves, they taste fine.  There isn't that chalky aftertaste, they have a mild sweetness to them, and they also aren't overloaded with "flavoring" to try and cover up a bad taste.  I just prefer to mix them together with some berries to make a water based smoothie to get more of a morning meal out of it for myself.
I also met the owner and she talked at length about the creation of the product and the years of R&D she did, and her nutritionist background.  This was created by someone who believed in it and took the time to do it right, not by some corporation just trying to sell you something.
Definitely worth a try.

title: There is a right way...and a very wrong way to drink this!
body:
When I first received this product, I had 2% cow's milk left over, so I used that to blend. DO...NOT...USE...COW'S MILK! It was so horrible, I had to hold my nose and chug. I really needed the benefits of the product, so I pushed through, but next time tried So Delicious coconut milk, this was an improvement. I also found that it wasn't half bad with Bai's coconut/pineapple water. The next try was Silk Vanilla, sweetened...another step in the right direction. By the end of the container, I had discovered Silk Vanilla, unsweetened---BINGO! It actually is pretty good! The flavor is much much better, I can now drink it like a normal beverage (mixed in a shaker). The effects of this product are exactly as they describe and I am now ordering my second container. The reviews you see where people are saying the taste is absolutely unbearable are probably valid opinions, based on what they mixed it with. I'm not saying your eyes will fly open in the morning and you'll run to your shaker in anticipation of an amazingly delicious treat, but I don't think it's going to be something you find dreadful either. Just shop around and try some different combinations and find what suits your palate : )
Yes, the texture is not smooth- they're seeds, they aren't going to dissolve...but you just have to tell yourself before you get started that this isn't supposed to feel like drinking a milkshake- it's designed for medicinal purposes, and it's not a perfect world. As someone who has struggled with GI issues my ENTIRE life, I am over the moon pleased with the results from this cleanse. Gentle and consistent!

My shaker bottle holds 24oz or I would have pulled it out. Seemed silly for such a small drink.

I'm planning to experiment with dissolving in a smaller amount of warmer or even hot water and then adding room temp or cool water to that. Or even just hot water, like an herbal tea. I purchased the life bundle and although I started out using all of them every day on the time schedule provided I now have my own schedule. I have terrible time going #2 and have tried everything from over the counter to scripts. Nothing works. I use the cleanse everyday, first thing in the morning and sometimes its immediate while other days a few hours. The great thing is, well, it's not violent  or make u feel bad. It feels very natural. I initially bought these to help get animal products out of my diet and also to help keep me full. I was hungry almost every hour. Felt like I had a tape worm. I started using these and has helped me SOOOO much. I'm eating like a normal person now. Also, another plus for me is I am low carb..   all of these in one day total 18 carbs. That was a non negotiable for me to buy these. Its helped me accomplish what I set out to accomplish when I bought these. The green,red and orange - they arent the best tasting but yeah, they work fine and arent awful. I add different fruits and veggies to complement them. Find your combo. The protein powder I use ONLY when I'm feeling more hungry than normal. I love adding fruits to this and the pineapple powder.  I use almond / coconut milk mixture by silk in these 2 as well. I have to say that the milk gives it a much better creaminess than water. If I add veggies and fruits I will put equal parts milk and water as the bananas and avacado thickens it. 
I'm really hoping to see weight loss over time.  But I'll review this about 6 months in. 
All in all, I'd say it does what I need. I'm getting blood work done and have another doctors appointment in April. we shall see if there are metabolic and weight change then. I went to the doctor a few weeks before staring so I feel I have a good angle on where I was ahead of the life bundle. I cant wait to see the long term changes this bundle provides. Thanks SPJ!!! 
Thx for reading.

body: I started with the pineapple chia cleanse to help with digestive issues I encounter as a Type1 diabetic (for 34 years, Im 45). I definitely started feeling less bloated and better after a few days. I ran out for about a week and definitely felt the difference. So I finally tried the sampler I received and was all in. The green organic greens and the revive beet are both energy boosters. and have helped me tremendously with my tough work schedule. I am also intermitant fasting (M/W/F12-8) on alternate days. On those days, I drink the cleanse around noon with 8oz of unsweetened coconut milk, 2 splenda, dash of cinnamon, 3ish drops of vanilla and tsp of chia seeds. Blend in my bullet. It is so satisfying.  During the rest of the afternoon, I fill my 22 oz water bottle up twice. Once with the organic greens and then with the revive beets (might have to switch..it is such a boost). I also add a packet of my favorite water flavoring. To stave of issues I have a handful of nuts during the day and small salad at night. Im really not hungry. I am oversharing because it is impossible, for already healthy type1 diabetics to lose weight. The more you control your sugar, the more weight you gain. Insulin is fat storing hormone and as a type 1 diabetic you have a constant basal and you regularly bolus. Also when you have a 24/7, 365-day, over 34 years, with no break condition; you don't really have the strength, desire or will to diet. The intermittant fasting in combination with a healthy way to feel satisfied during the day has made a world of difference. On my off days, I still watch what I eat, but I eat what I want. I have my slice of pizze or 5 guys BLT. I had a krispy cremem the other day. I even have my Bailey's at night every once in a while. And I am losing weight. woowoo. So yeah...Im a fan.

The Vegan Protini mixed with the pineapple chia is fantastic combo, I have it every morning for breakfast after my workouts. Before My 5am workouts I enjoy the beets with some apple juice. These products have now become my staple and are on auto delivery!! Thank you for creating some so delicious and healthy😊

title: Vivrant Beet Root Juice that is a Nitrate Superstar
body:
I have used Smart Pressed Juice's Greens so I was a excited to their new Beet Root cold press. This beet root powder comes with scooper that portions out 30 servings. At about $1.15 a glass, it's a much cheaper and almost equally effective way of getting your beet root push vs. waiting for a $6-8 fresh pressing of beet root at your local juice store.

I have been trying this for two weeks, about every other day and after having it in the morning I do feel alert. My blood pressure has also fluctuated less (staying on the lower side) so I'm thinking that's because I'm getting consistent nitrates.

If just mixing with 6 oz of cold water, the powder needs a few good stirs and then your cleanse drink is ready to go. It has that bright red/burgundy color that you would expect with beet based juices. It has a little spice kick to it, not spicy, spicy, but just a little kick from the tumeric and ginseng that says to me, "Hey, we're here!" It has a light bit of sweetness to it. If you prefer masking the beet root flavor, I think carrot juice would be amazing with this or 6 oz of orange juice would do the trick too.

One thing I noticed was that this came in the same bottle size as the cold pressed greens but was only 2/3 filled. I did a comparison and the weighted product inside both bottles is 150 grams, the beet root powder is heavier and denser. The scoop spoon in the beet root bottle is also about 1/3 smaller in size, so that made sense. So if you get the bottle and you only see that it's 60% full, don't panic, the product inside measures out to at or above 150 grams.

Overall, Smart Pressed Juice's Beets + Roots is exactly what I was hoping for and expecting for this product. Non GMO, only 2 grams of sugar, no soy, no gluten or artificial fillers, I'm keeping this in my juice cleanse rotation!

title: Totally Worked For Me
body:
Starting off with results. I'm at the top of my 6th day and have already lost 5.8 lbs. And real pounds - not water weight.

I tried the 7 day cleanse after about a month of eating really poorly. I was bloated, felt terrible and desperately needed a reset. I read many of the reviews going into this, particularly regarding the taste of the products. I used unsweetened almond milk to mix with the vanilla powder and the pineapple at night and I used Diet V8 Splash tropical blend for the greens. The vanilla powder is thick - tastes a little like drinking pancake batter, but the taste is fine and it's totally doable. With the V8 the greens tasted exactly like the juice at first taste (despite looking like a dark green drink). I won't lie, the aftertaste was a little funky, almost peppery, but nothing so terrible. The pineapple was surprising bland,  but there are a lot of little chia seeds. For the lunches I either did a small chicken breast or small piece of salmon with a spinach salad. I was surprised how very rarely I felt hungry.

Drawbacks - I missed eating, like the physical sensation. The only time I ever really felt hungry was usually between the 3:00 pm Greens and the 6:00 pm Vanilla, but it wasn't like a famished feeling so waiting was fine.

Overall - I would definitely do it again. I stuck to the regiment very strictly - timed everything out with the suggested times (though I did move everything back an hour so I could sleep in Sat and Sun) - and only ate the one meal at lunch time.

The next day I did the same thing, taking the supplement and going to the gym. Only this time, when I weighed myself, it told me I was 182 now.
I know, I couldn't really believe it.
Good thing I also use my digital scale at home and, yeah. I for sure lost 5 pounds in one day.
I know it seems like an unhealthy amount of weight to lose in one day, but it makes sense knowing what I was eating before I started.

However,
I can't really give this my 5 star because, well,
The first day I felt great. I was just starting on this and everything was going fine (Although, the powder texture is quite unbearable and the green juice is just, well... safe to say I had to brush my teeth after each drink of that). But by the end of the second day, I felt like I was gonna pass out. I was hydrated, peeing almost ever 15 minutes, but I don't think the powder and the single meal a day was really enough to sustain my body.
By the third day I weighed myself to be 178.
So, 9 pounds down in 3 days.
Can't say the same will happen for everyone else but, hey, if you had a diet and body similar to mine, maybe it's worth checking out.

title: If You Have Kidney or Other Health Issues This May Not Be For You!
body:
I have a kidney disorder that affects my body's ability to filtrate, particularly my potassium and sodium.  I have done juice cleanses in the past without any issues but this holiday season I tried this version solely based on cost (after holiday spending I didn't feel like spending $100 on my usual cleanse by RAW which, by the way, is amazing.) I should have read about this more carefully.  It's basically water/juice with minimal nutrients mixed into it from the packets. I fell for the price, and the packaging, and the positive reviews of others who may have had a good experience but don't have the physical issue that I do.  My first evening I went into hypokalemia where your potassium gets so dangerously low that it causes muscle to paralyze, numbness, pain, tingling in your extremities, shortness of breath, excessively high blood pressure, and very high heart rate - it's really dangerous.  All that said, there is virtually no potassium in this cleanse which I now realize since I read the labels more carefully after the experience. This "cleanse" might be fine if you're physically totally healthy, but I am not and I should have been more careful with what I chose.  If you have any physical conditions you should think twice about this particular cleanse.  I wanted everyone to know that so that if you do have physical complications you do not fall into the situation I did.

I gave it two stars, not just because of that experience (that was really my fault, had I checked more carefully I would't have purchased this) but also because I've done other cleanses and overall this one just lacks. Sure it's about half the price, but you really do get what you pay for. Compared to other cleanses this has REALLY low nutritional value, and it's not filling either, as a result.  It is low sugar so it's go that going for it, but that's because it's low on everything else, too. It has virtually no nutrition when you think about what you need in a day. This didn't go away and wasn't water weight and I ended up going back to my normal eating habits to drop the weight again. This is mainly water and protein so your body may react as mine did. If you have a lot of weight to loose I could still see this working for you to change eating habits and reset just wasn't for me

title: I loved it. ❤️🌱❤️🌱
body: What’s not to like. Although the protein is not the best I’ve ever had, it’s just fine. The greens are delicious and the chia cleanse is good too. I tried all with water the first day, then with the protein I mixed with almond milk and blended in some organic berries. It keeps you full. And with that mid day clean meal, this is a program that is easy to stick with. I plan on making it part of my regular vegan diet. It’s a great little reset and the price is great. I would recommend to anyone! ✌🏻

title: Works as described
body: I've always been afraid of trying cleanses, because of I thought I might feel on one.  This brand had a one day pack that I could try out before going for the longer ones, so I decided to do it after traveling and having a pretty free week with trying new food.  I was a little nervous about the taste, but after reading some of the reviews, I decided to try mixing it with apple juice and it was  perfectly fine.  The cleanse worked as described and for me personally, I didn't feel too deprived. It's also easy and even though I didn't go anywhere the day I did it, it's a plus that the packets are easy to take with me.  Definitely will be trying the longer version now.

title: New to Juice Cleansing?
body: I am new to this process of juice cleansing and wanted to try something that was a little more portable. I had tried several juices which required chilling during delivery to me, chilling until use and often they had a short shelf life.  I needed something that I could order and have on hand until my schedule allowed me to use them. These packets fit my daily schedule/need for portability and I felt like ~ they really worked.  I would recommend this product.

title: Recommended Cleanse
body: I really liked this cleanse.  It is very reasonably priced, tasted decent, and was easy to follow.  It was also convenient for on-the-go cleansing.  I was able to complete it at work without a juicer, which made it soooo much easier.  I lost about 6 pounds in three days.  It wasn't my goal to lose a ton of weight, but I needed to cleanse my system.  It did help to greatly reduce my junk food cravings, and did a good job of pushing the reset button on my digestive system.  I would recommend!

title: Perfect For On The Go People
body:
I'm on the go all day.
But yet, still wanted to have a juice cleanse.
Here's what I like and why.

WHAT I LIKE
Easy to travel with. Just add water. {I did find a blender to make it a bit better}
Flavor is good. It's not high sugar like juices.
Price is fantastic for what you get.
Good amount of servings per day.
Packaging is good, small, simple and with a great instruction guide.
I don't like dragging a bag of juices around all day - so this is great.
Also great when I travel to other cities. Just throw in my bag and keep it going.

WHAT COULD BE BETTER
I think the protein portion could be a bit bigger.
Maybe it's just me or my stomach telling me I'm hungry ;)

Hope this helps.
Happy Juicing.
- anthony

title: Great kickstart to better eating!
body: I bought this product on a whim after a fun filled Fourth of July week of parties- lots of drinking and eating terribly! I needed a reset, and turned to amazon. I picked this product bc of the reviews, the price and that it was organic and non gmo. I split the 6 packets and had three each day- vanilla shake for breakfast, veggie drink for snack, salad for lunch and the pineapple juice for an afternoon snack with a healthy dinner. I really enjoyed all of them! I did not look for weight loss, really just more of a reset. I felt less bloated after, and less lethargic. Would definitely purchase again.

Only disappointing thing is the protein had coconut in it which I can’t have :( but gave it to a coworker who enjoyed it. I love the ease of it being proportioned and easy for on the go drinking.

title: A great way to start your health journey
body: I recently completed the 7 day cleanse and it was easier than I thought. I worried that I would be hungry with just having 5 shakes a day and one clean meal but surprisingly I was full. The first day I made all shakes with just water to get the true taste, had my clean meal which was a nice size salad no meat and just lemon juice with evoo as the dressing. Water and hot lemon water in between. By the end of the 7 day cleanse, I had made most of the smoothies you receive when you join the Facebook group, I slept better, I was not suffering from any headaches and my stomach was significantly less bloated. The scale read a loss of 4.7 pounds. My body felt so good, I decided to order the full set including the immunity to continue on my journey.  I'm an active member in the Facebook group and the other juicers and admins are so supportive. I'm a huge fan of Smart Pressed Juice
